items.subject: The knowledge store's nightly pass went RED
evidence: ~/.claude/recall-sleep-latest.md 2026-09-22 05:49: reflex fire rates exit 1, forgetting exit 1, memory clusters exit 1, gate exit 1, VERDICT: FAIL with FAIL (10)
select-first-in-writing-pipeline 225 of 5588 real commands (4.03%) against a 3% cap; 224 of the 225 had a READER upstream (Select-String 77, Get-Content 48, git 35, a variable or assignment 41)

concurrent-publish-shared-tree 6 of 191 meal-prep commands (3.14%) against 2%; all 6 were publish.ps1 -Slugs / build-cards.ps1 -Slugs from session 97732561 in the private worktree .claude/worktrees/i143-b1 on 2026-09-19, one of them running the Win32_Process check the row asks for
clusters: 3 same-project unruled over a mark of 0 and 11 cross-project over a mark of 9 (7 and 11 by 14:10 as the store grew); forgetting: 2 unruled sections (synced/morning, synced/skill-creator)

the gate's recognition-floor check opened the LIVE index (recall_index.ready) two dozen steps after 'derive floors', after the pass itself had moved the store; the same gate also reported the lexical and semantic indexes out of step (2206 chunks against 1988 vectors)

Task Scheduler: TC Recall Sleep 0435 LastTaskResult 0 at 12:35 while ops/out/logs/run-once/recall-sleep-2026-09-22.stamp read rc=1; measured: conhost.exe --headless powershell.exe -Command 'exit 7' exits 0, the same child run directly exits 7

after: the whole pass run at 14:47 exited 0 on every one of 30 steps; check-skills exit 0, 64 of 64, select-first 11 of 5579 (0.20%), concurrent-publish 0 of 165, clusters 23 with 0 unruled and 12 cross-project with 0 unruled, recognition floors within band on the frozen snapshot
items.root_cause: The pass judged proxies and a moving target, and its exit could not carry the verdict. Two reflex patterns keyed on the wrong feature (select-first on a pipe DOWNSTREAM of -First, when the harm is to the script UPSTREAM; concurrent-publish on any publish/build-cards call, when the hazard is a whole-catalog run in the shared tree). The recognition floor was derived on one state of the index and judged on another, so a re-run gave a different verdict. The judgement ratchets sit at a mark over a store that grows daily and nothing had ruled on them since 2026-09-18. And since I236 (2026-09-18) the task ran under conhost.exe --headless, which returns 0 whatever its child returns, so the heartbeat read a failing pass as healthy (gap F4).

root_fix.what: Tighten both patterns and measure them over the same corpus; freeze the index and probe corpus the floors are derived on and judge them on that snapshot; rule every cluster and forgetting candidate by the store's procedure; make the exit carry the report's verdict and launch the task through a windowless launcher that returns its child's code.
root_fix.exact_change: select-first fires only when an element UPSTREAM of -First in the same statement is a .ps1, & on a quoted script/interpreter/$variable, powershell/pwsh, python/py/node or cmd /c: 225 -> 11 of 5588 (0.20%), 10 of the 11 new fires the old pattern missed. concurrent-publish fires only on publish.ps1 -All and build-cards.ps1 with no -S(lugs): 6 -> 0 of 191, still firing on the draft's 3 real founding commands. recall_floors --calibrate refreshes the live index once, copies it with sqlite backup to ~/.claude/recall-floors-snapshot.sqlite3 with the probe corpus, derives on the copy and records it in _meta.snapshot; recall-hook-calibrate judges on that copy. 22 clusters ruled (2 gist, 11 cued, 9 distinct; 4 of the 22 were created by the gists' fades), CROSS_UNRULED_MARK 9 -> 0 after the count reached 0; 2 forgetting sections retired from the index. recall-sleep exits 1 on a broken step and 3 when nothing broke but the report says VERDICT: FAIL. The task runs pythonw.exe headless-exit.pyw --headless <the same powershell command>.

prevention.what: the emitter's exit now carries its verdict to the scheduler, the floor verdict cannot move with the store, and the two reflex rows are measured on what they exist for; 2026-09-11-18da92 split a waiting judgement from a broken step but let the waiting night exit 0, which is the half this item reverses on Brad's ruling
prevention.exact_change: task action pythonw.exe + headless-exit.pyw (child's exit code passes through); recall-sleep returns 1/3 on FAIL; floors derived and judged on one frozen snapshot; reflex patterns keyed on the upstream writer and the whole-catalog run

items.leaves_open: 1 residual: the judgement queues (clusters, forgetting) still grow with each day's memory writing and only a person rules on them, so a night with a new cluster reports VERDICT: FAIL and now exits 3, which health-heartbeat pages as TASK FAILED. Unruled clusters or candidates were the cause on 7 of the last 8 logged runs.

items.subject: Weekly lane residual: three automations that fail in their own right, which RESUME-GRACE does not touch
evidence: run-once stamps vs Task Scheduler, 2026-09-22: recall-sleep rc=1 on 09-20, 09-21, 09-22 while LastTaskResult read 0; daily-ratchets rc=1 on 09-20, 09-21, 09-22 while TC Daily Ratchets 0315 reads 0; capture-watchdog rc=1 (by design) reads 0
10 of 12 TC tasks run as conhost.exe --headless since 2026-09-18 (backlog I236, commit 3e203a3de); TC Approvals Page and now TC Recall Sleep 0435 run under pythonw.exe
measured: conhost.exe --headless powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'exit 7' -> 0; powershell.exe run directly -> 7
items.root_cause: The item's recall-sleep third stopped paging on 09-18 not because it recovered but because the conhost wrapper that I236 put on every TC task returns 0 whatever its child returns. From that day health-heartbeat's LastTaskResult read is blind on 10 of 12 tasks; rows with a green-only proves stamp or a run_log still page through those, rows that rely on the exit code do not.

root_fix.what: a windowless launcher that returns its child's exit code, applied to the task this lane owns
root_fix.exact_change: Command pythonw.exe, Arguments '"...\headless-exit.pyw" --headless "<powershell.exe>" <the same arguments>'; the launcher hands on the rest of its raw command line verbatim with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and exits with the child's code; run-once-a-day's binding self-test peels it like conhost

items.leaves_open: the other 9 conhost-wrapped TC tasks still report 0 whatever they return (TC Daily Ratchets 0315's rc=1 on 3 of the last 3 days reads 0), and the item's other two automations (Graph Nightly's refused commit, Daemon Battery's exit 2) are judged by run_log and a green-only stamp, which this item did not change. Rewrapping them touches every registrar and the conhost check in ops/install-grocery-tasks.ps1, outside this run's permission.
